thread:
harper: Kicking off release v2.16.0 in EU change window (09:00-11:00). Step plan: 6 steps, start at 3% across routes: embeddings, rerank, text-gen.

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout started  job_id=rl-20260325-16  step=1  weights={v2.16.0:3,v2.15.2:97}
zane: Quick head's up watching slo panel: embeddings.p95 moved 150ms -> 390ms right at 09:04. 5xx nudged 0.1% -> 0.45%. Panel: https://console.redwood/slo?route=embeddings&range=10m
tess: Any infra anomalies? NVMe and GPU mem look steady. KV-cache miss rate up ~2x.
ops-bot: [alert] embeddings.p95 > threshold for 4m. Recommendation: pause rollout for embeddings and run a focused probe (1% traffic, 2m).
harper: Pausing embeddings ramp only. Do not touch rerank/text-gen. Run probe and attach traces.
deploy-bot: [automated] action=hold_rollout  job=rl-20260325-16  affected=embeddings
deploy-bot: [automated] run_probe  route=embeddings  target_version=v2.16.0  traffic=1%  duration=120s  probe_id=probe-6999990001
zane: Probe results: median probe latency 400ms, tail aligned with attention kernel hot path. Trace: https://traces.redwood/probe-6999990001
tess: Given previous regressions, recommend route-only rollback to v2.15.2 for embeddings. Prepare weight adjust and include audit token.
harper: Go ahead, include a brief release-note update and create ENG-5230 for runtime perf triage.
zane: Audit call: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/route-weight -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" -d '{"route":"embeddings","weights":{"v2.16.0":0,"v2.15.2":100}}'  # applied
audit-bot: [log] action=route-weight-change  user=zane  route=embeddings  from={v2.16.0:3}  to={v2.15.2:100}  ts=6999990028
deploy-bot: [automated] weights_updated  route=embeddings  job=rl-20260325-16-weights
zane: Watching SLOs: p95 back to ~160ms within 90s, 5xx to 0.08%. Good.
tess: I'll add a note in release notes: "v2.16.0 embeddings paused due to p95 regression; embeddings routed to v2.15.2. See ENG-5230." Also pin v2.15.2 as last-known-good for embeddings in config.
harper: Keep text-gen and rerank ramps moving. Do a post-mortem on the weight-pinning logic and add a perf test for long-context embeddings to the release checklist.
ops-bot: [summary] partial_rollback executed  affected_route=embeddings  followup=ENG-5230  note="probe->rollback"
harper: Thanks team. We'll reopen embeddings ramp after ENG-5230 fix and bench sign-off.
